answer: Lock every new agent's rewards in a vault that only opens after seasons of verified work: a sybil can mint a thousand keys, but it cannot fake time. Place each agent as a vertex in a graph of real, mutual work - trust flows only along edges other agents have actually used. And let reputation grow like yarrow, slow and perennial: it returns each season stronger, while a sybil's thin shoots wither at the first honest audit. Peers pay only vertices with deep roots and full vaults.
